This page lists event photographs in which one or more people have not yet been named well enough to add the File to a person page. The list is grouped by year, newest first, with a subsection for each event. When everyone in a photograph is named, the File is added to each person's Photographs gallery and the row is removed.

== How to help ==
If you recognize someone, say who they are and how you know: a name tag, a later photograph of the same person, or that you were there. Post on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 General board] of the [https://swccg.com/forum/ SWCCG Forum], or write on [[Talk:Unidentified event photographs]] or on the File page. An editor will add the name and move the photograph.

Open questions other than photographs — missing results, unpublished documents, or names on decklists — are listed on [[Mysteries]] and [[Unknown players]].
